title: Lingguizhugan decoction ameliorates renal injury secondary to heart failure by improving pyroptosis through TLR4/NF-KB/IRE1alpha pathway.
authors: Lv, Jiayu; Fu, Zhenyue; Wang, Yuxin; Chen, Chunmei; Wang, Yajiao; Zhang, Bingxuan; Wu, Huaqin; Song, Qingqiao; Li, Yumeng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苓桂术甘汤通过TLR4/NF-kB/IRE1alpha通路改善心衰继发肾损伤，核心为中药药理与细胞焦亡，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic heart failure (CHF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) mutually promote the onset and progression of each other. Renal injury caused by heart failure currently lacks effective treatments. Previous studies have shown that Linggui Zhugan decoction (LGZGD) can significantly improve heart failure (HF) and cardiac remodeling, and has been reported to have renal protective effects. However, the effects and mechanisms of LGZGD in heart failure-induced renal injury remain unclear. PURPOSE: Based on these findings, this study aims to investigate the effects and underlying mechanisms of LGZGD on renal injury secondary to HF. STUDY DESIGN: We used network pharmacology to predict potential targets of LGZGD in the treatment of cardiorenal syndrome (CRS). An in vivo model of CRS with right heart failure and venous congestion was established by a single intraperitoneal injection of monocrotaline (MCT). TNF-alpha-stimulated NRK52E cells were used as an in vitro model. We validated the effects of LGZGD in both in vivo and in vitro experiments,. Additionally, molecular docking with the components of LGZGD identified previously was performed to predict potential targets of action. RESULTS: LGZGD significantly improved heart and kidney function as well as renal histopathological changes in CRS rats. It inhibited the TLR4/NF-kappaB/IRE1alpha pathway in the kidneys and downregulated the expression of pyroptosis-related proteins (NLRP3, GSDMD, Caspase-1, IL-18, and IL-1beta). Both LGZGD-containing serum and the TLR4 inhibitor (TAK-242) significantly reduced apoptosis in TNF-alpha-stimulated NRK52E cells and decreased the levels of TLR4/NF-kappaB/IRE1alpha pathway signaling and pyroptosis-related proteins. Molecular docking suggested that neoliquiritin (CID_51666248), enoxolon (CID_10114), and liquiritin (CID_503737) could stably bind to key targets such as IRE1alpha, caspase-1, and NF-kappaB. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrated for the first time that LGZGD might ameliorate renal injury secondary to HF by improving pyroptosis through the TLR4/NF-kappaB/IRE1alpha pathway, which may provide valuable insights for future research in the treatment of CRS.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性心力衰竭（CHF）与慢性肾脏病（CKD）相互促进彼此的发生与进展。由心力衰竭引起的肾损伤目前缺乏有效治疗手段。既往研究表明，苓桂术甘汤（LGZGD）能显著改善心力衰竭（HF）及心脏重构，并已有报道显示其具有肾脏保护作用。然而，LGZGD在心力衰竭所致肾损伤中的作用及机制尚不明确。目的：基于上述发现，本研究旨在探讨LGZGD对继发于HF的肾损伤的作用及其潜在机制。研究设计：我们采用网络药理学预测LGZGD治疗心肾综合征（CRS）的潜在靶点。通过单次腹腔注射野百合碱（MCT）建立右心衰竭伴静脉淤血的CRS体内模型，并以TNF-α刺激的NRK52E细胞作为体外模型。我们在体内和体外实验中验证了LGZGD的作用。此外，对先前鉴定的LGZGD成分进行分子对接，以预测潜在作用靶点。结果：LGZGD显著改善了CRS大鼠的心脏和肾脏功能及肾脏组织病理学变化。它抑制了肾脏中的TLR4/NF-kappaB/IRE1alpha通路，并下调了焦亡相关蛋白（NLRP3、GSDMD、Caspase-1、IL-18和IL-1beta）的表达。含LGZGD血清和TLR4抑制剂（TAK-242）均显著减少了TNF-α刺激的NRK52E细胞凋亡，并降低了TLR4/NF-kappaB/IRE1alpha通路信号及焦亡相关蛋白的水平。分子对接提示，新甘草苷（CID_51666248）、甘草次酸（CID_10114）和甘草苷（CID_503737）能稳定结合IRE1alpha、caspase-1和NF-kappaB等关键靶点。结论：本研究首次证明，LGZGD可能通过TLR4/NF-kappaB/IRE1alpha通路改善焦亡，从而缓解继发于HF的肾损伤，这可能为未来CRS治疗研究提供有价值的见解。
